limitations: Curvature-channel eigenvalues describe the fitted three-band quadratic operator; when truncation splits H_eff(0), they are not Hessians of independently nondegenerate branches.
The source itself is scalar-relativistic and non-SOC, so standard physical HH, LH, and split-off labels are not assigned.
Polar transport controls basis freedom but does not make the candidate and source cluster subspaces identical; principal-angle evidence remains separate.
No DFT, Wannier90, refitting, independent reconstruction, or experimental validation was performed.

method.claim_boundary: degeneracy-aware non-SOC multiband curvature channels, not physical SOC HH/LH/split-off masses or individual-band Hessians
method.directional_channels: eigenvalues of twice the direction-contracted quadratic coefficient matrix
method.even_field: average of transported +q and -q three-band represented Hamiltonians
method.quadratic_form: H_eff(q)=H_eff(0)+q_x^2 B_xx+q_y^2 B_yy+q_z^2 B_zz+2q_xq_y B_xy+2q_xq_z B_xz+2q_yq_z B_yz
method.transport: polar unitary of the Gamma-cluster to displaced-cluster overlap
